base_template.name: Bootstrap Base Template

        {% block content %}        
        {% endblock %}

template.name: Client System Capacity (html)
template.template_variables:
data_sources:
  agents:
    filter:
      site__client_id: '{{client.id}}'
    model: agent
    only:
      - hostname
      - wmi_detail
      - total_ram
      - disks
      - operating_system
report_run_timestamp: !now
